questions.prompt: Rr × Rr (Japanese 4 O'Clock: RR = red, Rr = pink, rr = white): what percentage of the offspring have red flowers?
questions.explanation: 1 of 4 boxes are red = 25%.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: Today, flour beetles are not killed even by very _____ concentrations of the same pesticide.
questions.explanation: Today, flour beetles are not killed even by very high concentrations of the same pesticide.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: Rice, wheat, maize, sorghum and _____ were all developed from wild grasses by artificial selection.
questions.explanation: Rice, wheat, maize, sorghum and millet were all developed from wild grasses by artificial selection.

questions.prompt: Which set shows all the gametes of a plant with genotype YyVv?
questions.explanation: Each gamete gets one allele of each pair: YV, Yv, yV, yv.

questions.prompt: What does "Incomplete dominance" mean?
questions.explanation: Incomplete dominance: an allele does not completely mask the other, so the heterozygote shows a blend of both phenotypes.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: The genotype of red-flowered 4 O'Clock plants is _____.
questions.explanation: The genotype of red-flowered 4 O'Clock plants is RR.

questions.prompt: Rr × rr (Japanese 4 O'Clock: RR = red, Rr = pink, rr = white): what percentage of the offspring have pink flowers?
questions.explanation: 2 of 4 boxes are pink = 50%.

questions.prompt: RR × RR (Japanese 4 O'Clock: RR = red, Rr = pink, rr = white): what percentage of the offspring have red flowers?
questions.explanation: 4 of 4 boxes are red = 100%.

questions.prompt: Which term is defined as "the trait that dominates the phenotype in the F1 generation"?
questions.explanation: the trait that dominates the phenotype in the F1 generation = Dominant trait.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: The major cereals were developed by artificial selection between _____ years ago.
questions.explanation: The major cereals were developed by artificial selection between 7,000 and 12,000 years ago.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: About _____ of the F2 plants were tall in Mendel's monohybrid cross.
questions.explanation: About three-fourths of the F2 plants were tall in Mendel's monohybrid cross.

questions.prompt: In the F2 of TtVv × TtVv (T = tall, V = violet; t = short, v = white), what fraction of the plants are short white?
questions.explanation: The 9:3:3:1 ratio gives 1/16 for short white.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: The first step of natural selection is _____.
questions.explanation: The first step of natural selection is overproduction.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: Differences in traits between individuals of the same species are called _____.
questions.explanation: Differences in traits between individuals of the same species are called variations.

questions.prompt: Yy × Yy (Y = yellow (dominant), y = green): what percentage of the offspring will be yellow?
questions.explanation: 3 of the 4 Punnett boxes show the dominant phenotype = 75%.

questions.prompt: Parents with genotypes I^A I^B × I^B i: which blood groups are possible in their children?
questions.explanation: I^A I^B × I^B i gives genotypes I^A I^B, I^B I^B, I^A i, I^B i = groups A, B and AB only.

questions.prompt: Complete the statement: When two pink 4 O'Clock plants are crossed, the F2 genotypic ratio is _____.
questions.explanation: When two pink 4 O'Clock plants are crossed, the F2 genotypic ratio is 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr.

questions.prompt: What does "Hybrid" mean?
questions.explanation: Hybrid: an F1 offspring of two parents with different characteristics.
